articles.title: Lift Out of Service at Derker Tram Stop Until Further Notice
articles.excerpt: The lift at Derker tram stop is currently out of service, affecting access for passengers. Alternative step-free routes are available for travel towards and away from Manchester.
articles.content_html:
The lift at Derker tram stop is out of service as of 12 August 2026, and will remain unavailable until further notice. This disruption affects passengers using the tram service in both directions.

For those travelling towards Manchester, step-free access is available via a ramp from Cromford Street directly to the Manchester-bound platform. Passengers heading away from Manchester can also use a ramp from Cromford Street, but must cross the tracks to reach the Rochdale-bound platform.

Transport for Greater Manchester (TfGM) has issued an apology for any inconvenience this may cause to commuters and advises passengers to plan their journeys accordingly.

Further updates regarding the lift's status will be provided as they become available. For more information, visit the TfGM travel alerts page.
